lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nb2Cr4Ni8 (Nb(CrNi2)2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Cr and Nb each have eight Ni neighbors, while Ni has four Cr and four Nb neighbors, all at 2.4727 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Cr and Ni 8-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Cr–Cr and Ni–Ni polyhedra.
